characters.description: An adult female grad student working as a paleontologist, braided black hair, African ethnicity.

features.visual_identity: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. Characters have adult human proportions with soft, stylized, and slightly rounded edges. Expressive facial features.

apparel.upper: Muted green tee shirt worn UNDER a khaki safari vest

characters.pose: Engaged in careful field preparation, examining a split slab of stone with an air-scribe held aloft, smiling enthusiastically.
tools_held: Pneumatic micro-scribe tool with thin coiled air hose

embedded_assets.description: Exquisite, fully articulated pterosaur skeleton flat-pressed into a split limestone matrix.

features.anatomical_accuracy: Stylized-realism, elongated fourth digit wing finger, delicate skull with pointed beak
features.texture: Dark brown carbonized bone replacement contrasting sharply against light matrix

typography.integration: Nested physically into the upper rock ledge, casting clear shadows onto the limestone background
